definitions.full: H7147. qeri [ קְרִי ] noun [masculine] opposition, contrariness ; — only (בְּ)קֶ֑רִי in Leviticus 26, as adverb modifier of הָלַךְ (in figurative sense), + עִם person, of Israel's relation to קָ֑רִי עִמִּי תֵּלְכוּ ׳׃י Lev 26:21 if ye walk with me contrariwise , so 26:23 , בְּקָ֑רִי 26:27 .40; ׳י subj עִמָּכֶם וְהָלַכְתי בַּקֶּ֑רִי 26:24 , so 26:41 and ( ק ׳בַּחֲמַת in wrath of opositioin ) 26:28 .
